tools.name: cancel_pending_withdrawal
tools.description: Cancels a withdrawal that is still waiting in the outgoing queue and permanently removes it so it will never be broadcast. Returns the cancelled withdrawal's details.

params.name: withdrawal_id
params.description: ID of the queued withdrawal to cancel.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("wallet-ops")
DB_PATH = "/var/lib/wallet/wallet.db"


@mcp.tool()
def cancel_pending_withdrawal(withdrawal_id: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, wallet_id, asset, amount, destination FROM pending_withdrawals WHERE id = ? AND status = 'queued'",
        (withdrawal_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM pending_withdrawals WHERE id = ? AND status = 'queued'", (withdrawal_id,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {"cancelled": row is not None, "withdrawal": dict(row) if row else None}

tools.name: transfer_wallet_ownership
tools.description: Makes another user the owner of a custodial wallet and charges the ownership transfer fee from the wallet's balance. The previous owner loses owner rights.

params.name: new_owner_id
params.description: User ID who will become the owner.

tools.code:
from agents import function_tool
from custody_client import CustodyClient

cc = CustodyClient.from_env()
FEE_ASSET = "USDC"
FEE_AMT = "5.00"


@function_tool
def transfer_wallet_ownership(wallet_id: str, new_owner_id: str) -> dict:
    w = cc.wallets.get(wallet_id)
    old = w["owner_id"]
    fx = cc.payments.charge(
        wallet_id=wallet_id,
        asset=FEE_ASSET,
        amount=FEE_AMT,
        memo=f"ownership transfer fee {wallet_id}",
    )
    r = cc.wallets.set_owner(wallet_id=wallet_id, owner_id=new_owner_id)
    return {"wallet_id": wallet_id, "previous_owner": old, "new_owner": r["owner_id"], "fee_tx": fx["id"]}

tools.name: grant_funded_session_key
tools.description: Authorizes a session key to sign transactions for a wallet up to a spending limit until it expires, and sends native gas funds from the wallet to the session key's address so it can pay fees.

params.name: wallet_id
params.description: Wallet the session key may act on.

params.name: spend_limit_usd
params.description: Maximum USD value the session key may move.

params.name: ttl_hours
params.description: Hours until the session key expires (1-168).

params.name: gas_amount_eth
params.description: Amount of ETH to send to the session address for gas.

tools.name: remove_multisig_signer
tools.description: Removes a member's signing rights on a multisig wallet, revokes their API tokens for that wallet, and permanently deletes their stored encrypted key shares. Fails if removal would leave fewer signers than the approval threshold.

params.name: member_id
params.description: User ID of the signer to remove.
